ja: • 固定概念を打ち破った数多くの新機軸を採用し、ブルートレインの先駆けとして国鉄車両史に大きな影響を与えた。
• 夜行列車にふさわしい濃紺とクリーム帯の落ち着いた塗装、丸味を強調したデザインなど、洗練された印象で名車と言うにふさわしい車両。
• カニ21（カニ22）[電源車]、ナシ20[食堂車]、ナハネフ23[B寝台緩急車]、ナハネフ22[B寝台緩急車]の客車４両セット。
• カニ21とカニ22の作り分け用バリエーションパーツ（後面・屋根・パンタグラフ・妻板・台車レリーフ）あり。
• 電源車に関してはカニ21とほぼ同じ形状のカヤ21もステッカーの番号貼り替えで再現可能。マニ20についても、若干窓配置等は異なるが、代用で再現可能。
• 2016年11月発売のEF65-500、EF81と連結して編成を楽しめる。
en: • It adopted many new innovations that broke through stereotypes, and had a great impact on the history of JNR vehicles as the forerunner of the Blue Train.

• The vehicle is worthy of being called a famous car due to its sophisticated impression, such as the subdued dark blue and cream paint that is suitable for a night train, and the design that emphasizes roundness.
• A 4-car set of passenger cars: Kani 21 (Kani 22) [power supply car], Nashi 20 [dining car], Nahanef 23 [B sleeper train], and Nahanef 22 [B sleeper train].
• Variation parts for differentiating Crab 21 and Crab 22 (rear, roof, pantograph, gable board, trolley relief) are available.

• Regarding the power supply vehicle, Kaya 21, which has almost the same shape as Kani 21, can be reproduced by replacing the sticker number. Regarding Mani 20, the window arrangement etc. are slightly different, but it can be reproduced with a substitute.
• You can enjoy formation by connecting with 201611Release EF65-500 and EF81.
